title: Regular Installment Value Kept on a TRICARE Prime Fee Account After a Duplicate Payment
content:
Where part of a duplicate payment on a TRICARE Prime installment other than the first installment is kept on the fee account, a regular installment kept on the account is valued by the installment charge whose coverage period begins latest.

| Installment charge whose coverage period begins latest | A regular installment kept is valued at |
|---|---|
| a monthly installment | one twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (divided by 12), rounded to the cent |
| a quarterly installment | one quarter of that fee (divided by 4), rounded to the cent |
| otherwise | the whole annual fee |

## Hypothetical values (TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, individual, annual fee 390.12)

Latest-beginning charge monthly: 32.51. Quarterly: 97.53. Annual: 390.12.
